Meta.title: Ask your store. Get exact answers.
Meta.description: Connect your Shopify store and ask your sales data in plain language. Exact numbers, real charts, zero hallucinations.

Home.title: Connect your store. Ask your sales.
Home.subtitle: Exact answers, not approximations. Every number comes from a real query against your own data — never from a guess.
Home.status: Phase 2 — public demo. Store connection and accounts are next.

Landing.ctaNote: No sign-up. Real data from a demo store.
Landing.exampleQuestion: Which products sold the most in the last 30 days?
Landing.exampleSqlShow: Show the query that produced this
Landing.exampleAnswer: In the last 30 days, the top-selling product was the "Marble Bath Mat" with 26 units sold, followed closely by the "Stone Quilted Bedspread" with 25 units, and the "Marble Bath Towel Set" with 24 units sold. Other notable products include the "Brass Wall Art Print" at 19 units and the "Bamboo Picture Frame" at 18 units.
Landing.exampleFootnote: Actual output from the demo store, not a mockup. Every figure comes from the query above.

exact.title: The database does the maths
exact.body: The model writes the query; PostgreSQL computes the number. The answer is written from the real result, so there is nothing left to hallucinate.

proof.title: Every answer shows its query
proof.body: The executed SQL is one click away on every response. You do not have to trust us — you can read exactly what was measured.

insights.title: It keeps pulling the thread
insights.body: Each answer comes with things you did not ask about: trends, anomalies, opportunities. Tap one and it becomes your next question.

connect.title: Your own store, next
connect.body: The demo runs on a sample store so you can try it without signing up. Connecting your own store — Shopify sync and CSV upload — is what we are building next.

Demo.metaTitle: Live demo — ask a real store's sales data
